response.sql: WITH rating_film_counts AS (SELECT f.rating, COUNT(DISTINCT f.film_id) AS film_count FROM rental r JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id GROUP BY f.rating), rating_shares AS (SELECT rating, film_count, film_count / SUM(film_count) OVER () AS share FROM rating_film_counts), above_average AS (SELECT rating, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM rating_shares) SELECT COUNT(*) AS rating_count, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share FROM above_average WHERE share > average_share

assumptions.assumption: Uses the SQL engine's division semantics for computing shares; share is the count for a rating divided by the total count across ratings.
